images.filename: Montana de colores Cusco (Vinicunca) y Valle Rojo por Inka Time.jpg
images.caption:
The Mountain is located in the Cordillera del Vilcanota at 5,200 meters above sea level, in the district of Pitumarca, Cusco region.
The mountain of colors or Rainbow mountain, is a beautiful mountain of the Peruvian Andes whose characteristic is the amount of colors in its surface due to minerals and different types of rock.
Its beauty is on the surface, therefore, it is not allowed to walk in it, for a conservation issue.
To appreciate it in all its splendor, you climb the mountain in front of the Rainbow Mountain.

From where, in addition to seeing the Vinicunca, you can also observe breathtaking views of the Ausangate, and the entire valley to its surroundings.

images.caption:
Visit of Alberto Fujimori, President of Peru, to the CEC.
Jacques Delors, President of the CEC, and Abel Matutes, Member of the CEC in charge of Mediterranean Policy, Relations with Latin America and Asia (excluding Far East) and North-South Relations, received Alberto Fujimori, President of Peru, Carlos Torres y Torres Lara, Peruvian Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs. Discussions related to the recovery and good management of the Peruvian economy. The Commission declared itself satisfied with the results concerning the reintegration of Peru into the international economy. Also discussed were the efforts made by the country in the field of the internal peace-making process of Peru and the policies launched to tackle the issue of drug trafficking. Furthermore, cooperation between the Community and Peru was considered positive. Considering difficulties faced by his country, Alberto Fujimori submitted requests for financial support from the Commission, in the social and humanitarian fields as well as for the economic revitalisation of Peru, and requested the Commission support as regards the reintegration of Peru into the international financial circuits. It as also been decided to co-finance a joint-venture with the IFU, within the framework of the ECIP (European Community Investment Partners).

images.filename: Nichos en el cementerio de Umuto 01.jpg
images.caption: Nichos en el Cementerio de la Comunidad Campesina de Umuto, en el distrito de El Tambo, provincia de Huancayo, departamento de Junín, Perú. Este pabellón y los difuntos corresponden a algunos que fueron trasladados desde tumbas cercanas en el año 2013, por ello el tamaño reducido de los nichos dado que en el momento del traslado los restos de los difuntos solo se trataban de pocos huesos. Se observan entre las flores: gladiolos, rosas, astromelias, crisántemos, alhelíes, y claveles.

images.filename: Vista de Puno y el Titicaca, Perú, 2015-08-01, DD 53-54 PAN.JPG
images.caption: Panoramic view of the city of Puno next to the Lake Titicaca, in the Peruvian Andes, not far from Bolivia. Puno is the capital city of the Puno Province and has a population of approx. 150,000. It was established in 1668 by the Spanish nobleman and viceroy Pedro Antonio Fernández de Castro. The lake is, by volume of water, the largest in South America and, with a surface elevation of 3,812 metres (12,507 ft), it's considered the highest navigable lake in the world. The lake has a max. length of 190 kilometres (120 mi) and width of 80 kilometres (50 mi) and a surface of 8,372 square kilometres (3,232 sq mi), whereas the water volume is 893 cubic kilometres (214 cu mi) with a max. depth of 281 metres (922 ft) and an average depth of 107 metres (351 ft).
images.alt: Panoramic view of the city of Puno next to the Lake Titicaca, in the Peruvian Andes, not far from Bolivia.
